description: Bar widget to monitor IPs from interfaces, custom commands, or IPC.
name: IP Monitor

custom_command.description: Command to run to fetch the IP.
custom_command.label: Custom Command

details_font_size.description: Font size for the network details text.
details_font_size.label: Details Font Size

details_key_color.description: Color for the detail labels (e.g. Network, Mask).
details_key_color.label: Details Key Color

glyph.description: Icon to show before the IP.
glyph.label: Icon

hide_details_options.description: Comma-separated list of fields to hide in the details table (e.g. network,mask,iface).
hide_details_options.label: Hide Details Options

hide_on_empty.description: Hide the widget entirely when no IP is found.
hide_on_empty.label: Hide on Empty

hide_tooltip_options.description: Comma-separated list of fields to hide in the tooltip (e.g. network,mask,iface).
hide_tooltip_options.label: Hide Tooltip Options

iface.description: Pattern to match network interfaces (e.g. wlan*, eth0).
iface.label: Interface

ip_font_size.description: Font size for the IP and name text.
ip_font_size.label: IP Font Size

ipc_id.description: String ID used to target this specific widget via IPC JSON payload.
ipc_id.label: IPC ID

left_click_action.description: Action to perform on left click.
left_click_action.label: Left Click Action

name.description: Optional name to show next to the IP.
name.label: Name

refresh_interval.description: How often to refresh the IP (in seconds).
refresh_interval.label: Refresh Interval

right_click_action.description: Action to perform on right click.
right_click_action.label: Right Click Action

separator.description: Character to separate the IP and the name (e.g. -).
separator.label: Separator
